how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:leatherworking-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1582:obj:0: Bring 1 Embossed Leather ⟦E1⟧, 5 Embossed Leather Boots and 5 Embossed Leather Cloaks to Lotherias in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1582:details:0: We in ⟦E2⟧, especially we craftsman, are quite busy. Young adventurers are eager to test themselves in the wilderness, and are in constant need of supplies.
rows.quest:1582:details:1: BIf you can help me fill my orders of leather goods, then perhaps I can teach you an advanced leatherworking technique.
rows.quest:1582:completion:0: Yes, these are good pieces. You have a skilled hand and an eye for detail. Your future as a leatherworker is promising.
rows.quest:1582:completion:1: BHere, ⟦1⟧. Let me show you the pattern to make the Moonglow Vest.
rows.quest:2847:obj:0: Bring 10 ⟦E3⟧ to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2847:details:0: ⟦2⟧, you're becoming quite skilled as a leatherworker! I know some patterns you might be interested in... Wild Leather armor! Wild Leather taps into the potent and chaotic properties of wildvines, found in areas of lush vegetation and on some of the creatures there. The armor made using it is second to none for people of your skill, guaranteed.
rows.quest:2847:details:1: BI'll teach this to you, but you'll be working for me for a while. The first cost is simply ten pieces of thick leather. After this, we'll talk specifics.
rows.quest:2847:completion:0: Well ⟦3⟧, I'm glad to have you on board. You've made a smart decision as a leatherworker; those who wear leather armor will be clamoring to you once you learn how to make any of the Wild Leather armor pieces.
rows.quest:2847:completion:1: BLet's get to work - where do you want to start?
rows.quest:2848:obj:0: Bring 6 Thick Armor Kits and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2848:details:0: Wild Leather shoulders support the wearer's frame extremely well, offering top notch protection of the upper arms and the shoulders themselves. As with all Wild Leather armor, a potent but random benefit is applied to the item as the wildvine is stitched in.
rows.quest:2848:details:1: BFor this pattern, I will require six thick armor kits and a wildvine. That shouldn't be too tall of an order for you to fill.
rows.quest:2848:completion:0: These armor kits are of solid quality, ⟦4⟧. If there is one thing I demand in not only my work, but the work of those in my employ, it is quality.
rows.quest:2848:completion:1: BYou've done well to earn this pattern; I hope it brings you the rewards it has brought me.
rows.quest:2849:obj:0: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Breastplates, 2 Turtle Scale ⟦E1⟧, and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2849:details:0: Wild Leather vests are the staple of any Wild Leather armor set. The frame of the vest blends with the wildvine to produce a product that offers maximum protection of the torso while allowing for the potent magic to work its way through the garment.
rows.quest:2849:details:1: BFor this pattern, I will require two Turtle Scale breastplates, two sets of Turtle Scale gloves, and a wildvine. It's a tall order, but one you should have little difficulty in filling for me.
rows.quest:2849:completion:0: These are some very nice pieces here, ⟦5⟧. The craftsmanship and care put in to making these alone would fetch several silver more than the average piece made.
rows.quest:2849:completion:1: BYou've filled my order, and with that comes your reward. The knowledge of making Wild Leather vests is now yours!
rows.quest:2850:obj:0: Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2850:details:0: A Wild Leather helmet offers the wearer superior protection to the vital areas of the head without a sacrifice in comfort. As with all Wild Leather armor, the integrated wildvine yields a powerful but random enhancement to the frame of the helm. Leather wearers will definitely want this piece!
rows.quest:2850:details:1: BFor this pattern, I will need two Nightscape tunics, two Nightscape headbands, and a wildvine. Complete this order and the pattern will be yours!
rows.quest:2850:completion:0: This Nightscape equipment you have supplied fills the order perfectly, ⟦6⟧. I expect no less from a leatherworker of your caliber.
rows.quest:2850:completion:1: BYou have definitely earned this pattern. I give it to you freely, and hope you will profit from it accordingly.
rows.quest:2851:obj:0: Bring 2 Nightscape Pants, 2 Nightscape Boots, and 2 Wildvines to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2851:details:0: You've learned quite a bit now, ⟦7⟧; still, there is more for you to learn. Next are Wild Leather boots, the cornerstone of any set.
rows.quest:2851:details:1: BThese boots are crafted to cradle the foot in comfort while bracing it against the hazards of adventuring. The soft soles are a blessing to those seeking quiet movement in footwear.
rows.quest:2851:details:2: BFor this pattern, I need an order of two Nightscape pants and two Nightscape boots filled. I also will require two wildvines... not just one. When you have all this, let me know.
rows.quest:2851:completion:0: Once again, you've filled a complex order with the skill of a seasoned professional. You have earned this pattern, as well as my thanks.
rows.quest:2852:obj:0: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Helms, 2 Turtle Scale Bracers, and 2 Wildvines to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
rows.quest:2852:details:0: With the basics down, you are ready to master more complex fare, ⟦8⟧. Wild Leather leggings are some of the sturdiest and powerful leather gear around. The waist, thighs, calves, and the vitals - all are given tremendous protection. Coupled with the enhancement that the wildvine provides, adventurers who own it will thank you each time they see you.
rows.quest:2852:details:1: BFor this pattern, I need an order of two Turtle Scale helms, two Turtle Scale bracers, and two wildvines filled.
rows.quest:2852:completion:0: Again, you've filled an order without flaw. Perhaps some day I will come to YOU seeking knowledge, eh ⟦9⟧?
rows.quest:2852:completion:1: BHere is the pattern for the leggings, along with my thanks. Commit this lore to your knowledge, and let your finished products tap into your impressive skills!
rows.quest:2853:obj:0: Give Pratt's Letter to Telonis, the master leatherworker of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:2853:details:0: Well ⟦10⟧, you are the definition of diligence. There is one pattern left for Wild Leather armor; you've mastered the others. I won't require you to toil needlessly for the pattern. You've earned it outright, and then some... but I cannot give it to you myself. My teacher, the one who brought me into the craft, is the one who must reward you.
rows.quest:2853:details:1: BTake this letter to Telonis; he teaches leatherworking in ⟦E2⟧. Show him the letter, and let him acknowledge you as an equal, as I do.
rows.quest:2853:completion:0: Ah yes, Pratt sent you. Though he is a human, he reminds me of us night elves sometimes. His dedication and his talents with leather are impressive. For him to compliment you so in this letter, it is a sign of respect I acknowledge.
rows.quest:2853:completion:1: BI am aware that he has taught you the art of Wild Leather. Allow me to finish your training with this pattern. Make good use of it; few in the world know the secrets of Wild Leather cloaks.

rows.quest:5141:obj:0: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid ⟦E1⟧, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Peter Galen in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:5141:obj:1: BCompleting this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale ⟦E6⟧ arts.
rows.quest:5141:obj:2: BThe completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental ⟦E6⟧ and ⟦E7⟧ ⟦E6⟧; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
rows.quest:5141:details:0: Dragonscale leatherworking isn't easy, but it's extremely rewarding. I'll teach you how to make this fine mail armor, but only if you agree to certain conditions.
rows.quest:5141:details:1: BBy choosing this path, you agree never to learn elemental or tribal leatherworking; there is only room for one of the three at the apex of the craft. Furthermore, I'll need some samples of your best work involving scorpid armor. Finally, I'll need proof of your ability to acquire the staple of the trade: scales of the dragonkin.
rows.quest:5141:completion:0: I'll hand it to you - it takes a strong will to make a permanent decision like you've just done. I assure you, dragonscale leatherworking will prove to be a profitable and rewarding path for you to follow.
rows.quest:5141:completion:1: BTo train in the art for the future, simply speak to me and I will make available any knowledge that you have yet to commit as yours.
rows.quest:5143:obj:0: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Caryssia Moonhunter in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:5143:obj:1: BCompleting this quest will give you access to the ⟦E7⟧ ⟦E6⟧ arts.
rows.quest:5143:obj:2: BThe completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale ⟦E6⟧ and Elemental ⟦E6⟧; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
rows.quest:5143:details:0: To learn tribal leatherworking demands an understanding of how primal nature truly is; I know that you have already mastered the art of making wild leather armor, and I am willing to complete your training.
rows.quest:5143:details:1: BKnow this, ⟦20⟧: by choosing this path you agree never to learn dragonscale or elemental leatherworking; there is only room for practice of one of the three arts. Furthermore, bring to me the finest samples of your wild leather armor. From there, we will begin your mastery.
rows.quest:5143:completion:0: You've given your finest offerings, and nature will soon permit you to bend her to your will. Once I have finished my tutelage, your work will be a force of nature unto itself.
rows.quest:5143:completion:1: BTo train in the art for the future, simply speak to me and I will make available any knowledge that you have yet to commit as yours.
